question.text: Vaigai Agri Fund (Cat I): Committed INR 60 cr, Hurdle 12% compounded. Compute the incremental HURDLE RETURN accrued IN YEAR 2 only (not cumulative).

explanation.text: The Logic: End Year 1 Hurdle NAV = INR 60 x 1.12 = INR 67.20 cr. End Year 2 Hurdle NAV = INR 60 x (1.12)^2 = INR 75.264 cr. Incremental Year-2 hurdle = 75.264 - 67.20 = INR 8.064 crore. The workbook is explicit that closed-ended Cat I/II hurdles compound year-over-year, so Year 2 hurdle is 12% of the prior Hurdle NAV, not of the original committed capital. The Trap: A is the simple Year-1 hurdle; C is the cumulative 2-year compounded hurdle (15.264); D is a simple 12% x 2 yr x 60 cr calculation that ignores compounding. Note: For closed-ended Cat I/II hurdles, always step Year N off the prior Hurdle NAV rather than off the original commitment. Per workbook p.119 the hurdle is a compound rate.
